content_sections.text: Initially for 89 days on adhoc basis or till regular incumbents join, whichever is earlier Extension beyond 89 days admissible as per extant Rules of Deptt of H&FW, GNCTD on satisfactory work & conduct report Appointment and services governed under Residency Scheme of Govt. of India Waitlist panel valid for 06 months or till fresh selection process, whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: How Will IGH Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview Verification of certificates and medical fitness Registration 9.30 A.M. to 11.00 Noon on the day of interview Interview 10.00 AM onwards Decision of the selection board/Medical Director of IGH, Dwarka regarding selection is final Selection provisional, subject to verification of certificates/antecedents/DMC certificate and medical fitness

content_sections.text: Duly filled application form with two passport size photographs 10th and 12th pass certificates with marksheets MBBS Degree with marksheets of each year, Attempt Certificate and Internship Completion Certificate Post graduate Degree/Diploma with mark sheet and DMC Registration Certificate (MBBS/MD/MS/DNB) Caste certificate (reserved category) and Experience Certificate, if any Aadhaar card/Pan-card/Driving Licence and proof of permanent address

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IGH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 1 December 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IGH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: 4 Senior Resident (Medicine), 5 Senior Resident (Gen. Surgery), 1 Senior Resident (Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IGH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 1 December 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Seminar Room B6317, 5th Floor, Admin Block, IGH Dwarka.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for General, 48 years for OBC (belonging to Delhi only) and 50 years for SC/ST candidates (as on date of interview). Relaxation: OBC (belonging to Delhi only) 48 years, SC/ST 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs 67,700 Rs 2,08,700 ) and other allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Medicine), Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs 67,700 Rs 2,08,700 ) and other allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Gen. Surgery), Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs 67,700 Rs 2,08,700 ) and other allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MD/DNB/Diploma (Medicine, Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation) or MS/DNB/Diploma (Gen. Surgery); registration with Delhi Medical Council with MBBS and requisite Postgraduate qualification on or before the day of interview. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be registered with Delhi Medical Council (with MBBS and requisite Postgraduate qualification) on or before the day of interview. Should have valid DMC certificate or have applied for PG Degree/Diploma DMC on the date of interview. OBC/EWS certificate must be issued by Govt. of NCT of Delhi before the date of interview. OBC candidates must have Non Creamy Layer certificate for the current year.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who cannot join within 07 days of issue of the offer letter (offer cancelled automatically).

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Verification of certificates and medical fitness. Registration 9.30 A.M. to 11.00 Noon on the day of interview. Interview 10.00 AM onwards.
